nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, $\gcd(S_n, S_{n+1}, S_{n+2}) = 1$.
nodes.title: Three consecutive star numbers are relatively prime

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For natural numbers $p$, $n$ and $g$, $g$ is the $p$-Frobenius number of $S_n, S_{n+1}, S_{n+2}$ when at most $p$ triples $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers satisfy $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = g$, and every natural number $N > g$ has more than $p$ triples $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers with $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = N$.
nodes.title: $p$-Frobenius number of three consecutive star numbers

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For every natural number $n \ge 6$, the number of natural numbers $N$ for which at most one triple $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers satisfies $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = N$ is $25n^3 + 23n^2 + 14n + 1$.
nodes.title: $1$-Sylvester number of three consecutive star numbers

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For every natural number $n \ge 6$, the number of natural numbers $N$ for which at most two triples $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers satisfy $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = N$ is $33n^3 + 35n^2 + 20n + 2$.
nodes.title: $2$-Sylvester number of three consecutive star numbers

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For every natural number $n \ge 6$, the number of natural numbers that cannot be written as $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2}$ with $x, y, z$ natural numbers is $n(15n^2 + 8n + 7)$.
nodes.title: $0$-Sylvester number of three consecutive star numbers

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For natural numbers $p$ and $n$, the $p$-Sylvester number of $S_n, S_{n+1}, S_{n+2}$ is the number of natural numbers $N$ for which at most $p$ triples $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers satisfy $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = N$.
nodes.title: $p$-Sylvester number of three consecutive star numbers

nodes.summary: Write $S_m$ for the $m$-th star number $6m(m-1)+1$. For natural numbers $n$ and $N$, the representation count of $N$ is the number of triples $(x, y, z)$ of natural numbers with $x S_n + y S_{n+1} + z S_{n+2} = N$.
